answer: Concrete mechanism: stake bonding with slashing. Each agent locks its own collateral to earn a reward slot, so a Sybil attacker who splits one identity into a thousand forks must post a thousand separate bonds. Any detected impersonation slashes the entire stake, making the cost the full bonded capital rather than one account. Even at a token-price nadir, scaling needs fresh ivory collateral for every fake identity, so a sudden comet swarm of clones burns real funds and collapses the moment bonds are seized.
